HI Scott, Need some advice on the new Vamp rule :)

cards roughly give or a take a few 100, now with the new Vamp rule I have to
explain to these guys with the already limited amount of vamps they have
they cannot mix there 1's and 3's now due to the fact that there collections
are small and the amount of CE they would buy woud be small to they are
faced with a bit of a pickle I have been chewing on this for a few days and
thought you could provide me with and bit of insight or anyone else could :)
thanks

Errol
--
Immortal Grapple Cards

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


They're free to ignore the rule, of course, just as some groups ignore
the library size limitation rule and the bleed defaults to prey rule.
Whatever makes the game enjoyable for them and their group.

The new cards won't limit their existing cards any - any decks they could
build can still be built. The library cards found in CE can be used to
enhance those decks.

Or they can buy precons and use CE boosters (vampires and all) and their
own supply of library cards and group-2 vampires to enhance those.
